title: tithymalus lathyris
intro: Tithymalus lathyris, commonly known as the Euphorbia lathyris or Candelabra Plant, is a plant species that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and pain, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and anti-cancer activities. The therapeutic actions of Tithymalus lathyris include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and aid in the treatment of various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phyllodulcin, a glycosidic compound, and other flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
